paper.algorithm: Algorithm 1: three-way cross-fitting with global n/N scaling and evaluation-fold-size aggregation

official_repository.scope: Pinned external parity reference; not vendored and not used as the v2 cross-fitting oracle because it predates the v2 paper.

shared_reppi.coefficient: evaluation-fold sample covariance divided by sample prediction variance
shared_reppi.singular_rule: labeled-mean contribution when prediction variance is numerically singular

mlp_cv.name: RePPI-MLP-CV
mlp_cv.inner_split: shuffled K-fold within the score-training outer fold
mlp_cv.candidate_order_tie_break: first candidate in the listed Cartesian-product order
notes: The two-hidden-layer candidate matches the depth described in the June-2026 paper.
The (32,32,32), alpha=0.0001 candidate contains the January-2025 public-code default.
The paper and repository do not publish a CV grid, so this frozen grid is a disclosed local extension.
